# CobWebZ

> CobWebZ is a web design and development studio in Colombo, Sri Lanka. We design and hand-code fast, secure, search-ready websites and web applications for businesses in Sri Lanka and abroad, and keep them running after launch. Every project starts with a discovery call and a fixed, written quote. Prices are in Sri Lankan rupees (LKR).

## Packages (one-time prices)

- Static Website, LKR 40,000: best for portfolios and landing pages. Up to 5 custom pages, responsive design, basic SEO, contact form with Google Maps, free WhatsApp contact form, .lk or .com domain with SSL for the first year, free Cloudflare hosting, 2 design revisions, 14 days of support.
- Business Website, LKR 70,000: best for growing businesses. Up to 8 pages, a content editor with a blog or news section, a product catalogue with WhatsApp ordering, advanced animations, advanced SEO and analytics, free WhatsApp contact form, domain with SSL for the first year, free Cloudflare hosting, 2 design revisions, 1 month of support. Worth LKR 95,000 at add-on prices.
- Web Application, LKR 120,000: best for online stores, bookings and member areas. Python/Django or PHP with MySQL, 5 pages, admin dashboard, one core feature (such as bookings or a store), customer accounts, security hardening, staging and live deployment, free WhatsApp contact form, domain with SSL for the first year, 2 revisions with admin training, 30 days of support. Hosting is LKR 5,000 a month.

## Add-ons

- Extra page: LKR 5,000 per page
- Advanced animations: LKR 5,000 (included in the Business Website)
- Advanced technical SEO and analytics dashboard: from LKR 5,000 (included in the Business Website)
- Product catalogue with WhatsApp ordering: LKR 10,000 (included in the Business Website)
- Logo / mini brand kit (logo, colours and fonts): LKR 7,500
- Google reviews section: LKR 3,000
- Copywriting: LKR 2,000 per page
- Interactive 3D models: from LKR 15,000
- Dark mode toggle: LKR 4,000
- Payment gateway setup: from LKR 20,000
- Multilingual support (for example English, Sinhala and Tamil): from LKR 3,000
- Legacy data migration: from LKR 10,000
- Google Business Profile and Maps setup: LKR 5,000
- Business email setup (Google Workspace): LKR 3,000, plus Google's own monthly fee per user
- Extra design revision round: LKR 3,000
- Rush delivery: plus 25% of one-time work
- Audit of an existing website (speed, SEO and security): LKR 10,000

## Monthly plans

- Web application hosting: LKR 5,000 a month (static and business websites are hosted free)
- Basic maintenance plan (updates, backups, uptime): LKR 5,000 a month
- Content management retainer (4 updates or posts): LKR 5,000 a month

## How we build

- Static and business websites: semantic HTML, modern CSS and JavaScript, hosted on Cloudflare
- Web applications: Python/Django or PHP with MySQL, deployed with Docker, Nginx or Apache on Linux servers
- Every site is responsive, tested on phones, tablets and desktops, checked with Lighthouse, and served over HTTPS with security headers
- No page builders or third-party themes
